in_marathi.name: Lakhvinder
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Wealth, Prosperity, Power
in_marathi.long_meaning: Lakhvinder हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Lakh means 'hundred thousands' and Vinder means 'conqueror' or 'finder'. This name signifies the power of wealth and prosperity. In Hindu mythology, it is believed that the goddess Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth, blesses the one with this name with abundance and prosperity.
